metadata.unit: AEDC reporting area (one or more ASGS 2021 SA2s), Greater Melbourne

needs.label: Early development at school entry
needs.explains: Share of children in the area on track when they start school (AEDC 2024), adjusted for small numbers of children.
needs.does_not_confirm: This is an area-level census result. It does not predict how any child will develop.

needs.label: Social and emotional development
needs.explains: Share of children on track for social competence and emotional maturity at school entry (AEDC 2024).
needs.does_not_confirm: This is an area-level census result, not an assessment of local services or schools.

needs.label: Physical development and outdoor play
needs.explains: Children on track for physical health at school entry, and the share of land that is public open space.
needs.does_not_confirm: Open space is measured from 2018 land data; it does not rate playground quality.

needs.label: Shade and cooler streets
needs.explains: How much hotter the area runs than surrounding non-urban land, and its tree cover (2018).
needs.does_not_confirm: These describe the whole area in 2018, not a particular street today.

needs.label: Fewer traffic and industry sources
needs.explains: Traffic on main roads per square kilometre (2019) and industrial sites that report air emissions (2024-25).
needs.does_not_confirm: These count sources of pollution. They are not measured air quality.

needs.label: GP access
needs.explains: General practices within reach, allowing for neighbouring areas and how many people share them (2025), and the distance to the nearest one.
needs.does_not_confirm: Listing does not confirm a GP is taking new patients or bulk bills children.

needs.label: Childcare and kinder access
needs.explains: Approved childcare places within reach per child under 5, and kindergarten services per 1,000 children under 5 (2026).
needs.does_not_confirm: Approved places are service capacity. They do not confirm available places.

needs.label: Primary schools and public transport
needs.explains: Primary school campuses per 1,000 children aged 5-9 (2025) and public transport stops per 10,000 residents (2026).
needs.does_not_confirm: This counts schools in the area. It does not show school zones or enrolment.
